title: AssistantConversationResponse
description: Response body of GET /api/assistant-conversations/:id (HEL-663) and POST /api/assistant-conversations (create) -- the summary fields plus the full transcript. The transcript crosses the wire as opaque JSON (an array of ClaudeToolMessage-shaped objects, com.helio.ai) rather than a strictly-typed shape -- see AssistantConversationProtocol.scala's header comment for why. RLS-scoped to the owner; 404 for a missing or non-owned id. `hopBudgetExhausted`/`searchedWithNoResults` (HEL-667) are ephemeral signals describing the turn that just completed -- present only on a POST /:id/converse response, always absent on GET.

transcript.description: The full conversation transcript -- an array of ClaudeToolMessage-shaped turns: { role: string, content: [...] }.

hopBudgetExhausted.description: HEL-667: true when the just-completed converse turn hit the 3-hop tool-call cap before a final answer. Only present on a POST /:id/converse response; absent on GET.

searchedWithNoResults.description: HEL-667: true when the just-completed converse turn's last tool call was a zero-result find immediately followed by a final answer with no captured proposal. Only present on a POST /:id/converse response; absent on GET.
